dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Toto is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns in his previous home. In the care center, Toto has shown fearful behavior and has not acclimated, becoming anxious and spinning incessantly in his kennel. During his trial adoption, Toto reportedly lunged toward unfamiliar people, dogs, and small animals. He was also reported to have lunged and attempted to bite a male member of the household. He did have a scratch incident in care with a staff member. He was jumping up, attempting to push, and trying to jump out of the top kennel once the door was open. Toto scratched the staff member's upper and lower lip, drawing minimal blood. Toto is reported to be friendly and outgoing with the children and strangers. Medically, Toto is apparently healthy.

Toto came into ACC as a stray. He was returned from a trial adoption, so we have limited information about his behavior at home. Toto was returned due to growling and lunging at one of the adopters. Toto attempted to bite one of the adopters multiple times, but no contact was made. His trial adopters note that Toto will lunge at unfamiliar dogs, strangers, and small animals while on leash. His trial adopters note that he likes to sit on people's laps and that he enjoys pets. During his time in the care center, Toto has been noted to solicit pets from handlers and to allow for pickup. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
